repository_entries.description: Pin installation to stable v1.1.0 and record verified publication acceptance for the Logger raw-event release.
Simplify the documentation release history to concise version entries and user-facing changes.
Categorize release history and describe concrete features, fixes and upgrade requirements.
Add a welcoming documentation homepage with quickstart and utility entry points.
Start utility guides with installation and focused examples, followed by common tasks and optional reference details.
Make tracing optional in the first Lambda guide and track unsupported KMS data-key caching in a dedicated feature issue.
Publish phased issue and milestone tracking for unfinished capabilities and acceptance work.
Improve Go Powertools project identity, homepage search metadata and AI documentation discovery.
Complete first-party JSON v2 API adoption and enforce it in CI.
Document the finite Idempotency persistence audit and remaining acceptance gates.

# v1.2.0

All maintained public modules move to this version. Modules without file changes receive a version bump only.

**Scope:** 25 modules with changes; 2 version bumps only.

**Source:** [3018cd01c7c7](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/powertools-lambda-go/tree/3018cd01c7c7403b70bb399f3f16a79d407a672f)

**Publication status:** https://github.com/rambow-cloud/powertools-lambda-go/issues/229

One project Release contains these notes; independent Go modules use matching tags at the same commit.
